headlines.summary: 재경차관 "2분기 코스피 상승…순대외금융자산 감소 예상" 허장 재정경제부 2차관 (서울=연합뉴스) 허장 재정경제부 2차관이 2일 서울 종로구 달개비에서 열린 '외신기자 간담회'를 주재하고 있다. 2026.7.2 [재정경제부 제공. 재판매 및 DB 금지] photo@yna.co.

headlines.title: 코스피 장 초반 7000선 회복 ...15거래일 만
headlines.summary: 美 물가·반도체 훈풍 영향 코스피 지수가 미국의 인플레이션 우려 완화와 반도체주 강세에 힘입어 장 초반 7000선을 넘어섰다. 지난달 말 급락 이후 반등세가 이어지면서 15거래일 만에 다시 7000 고지를 밟았다. 14일 한국거래소에 따르면 코스피는 장 초반 전 거래일 종가(6813.34)보다 3% 안팎 오르며 7000선을 돌파했다.

headlines.title: 7월 가계빚 6.2조 늘어… 증가 폭 두 달째 둔화, 총량 확대 는 변수
headlines.summary: 올해 누적 증가액 35.3조원 주담대·신용대출 증가폭 ↓ 정부, 올해 가계대출 총량 목표 30조 확대 이억원 "실수요자 자금 공급하되 투기 수요 억제" 지난달 전 금융권의 가계대출이 6조원 넘게 늘어났다.

headlines.title: 수입물가 두달 연속 하락 … 반도체 호황에 수출물가는 상승
headlines.summary: 7월 수입물가 전달보다 1%↓ D램 등 주도 수출물가는 1%↑ 지난달 수입물가가 원·달러 환율과 국제유가 하락 영향으로 두 달 연속으로 떨어졌다. 반면 반도체 호황에 수출물가는 올랐고, 한국 경제의 대외 구매력을 나타내는 교역조건도 큰 폭으로 개선됐다. 14일 한국은행이 발표한 7월 수출입물가지수 및 무역지수에 따르면 지난달 수입물가지수는 160.

headlines.title: 정부 ‘ 주가 누르기 방지안 ’ 평가기간 확대

headlines.title: “ ISA , 청년 의견 담아 원래 혜택 유지… 비거주 1주택 , 예외 사유 폭넓게...
headlines.summary: 조세연·세무학회 주최 ‘세제개편안’ 토론회 재경부, ‘비거주1주택’ 예외 확대… ISA, ‘무제한 만기연장 및 연간한도 이월 폐지’ 철회 무게 주가누르기 방지책, 실효성 위해 강화 예고 토론회선 “부동산세제 개편, 급하면 조세저항” [이데일리 하상렬 김미영 기자] 당장 내년부터 종합부동산세 부담이 늘어나는 ‘비거주 1주택’의 예외범위가 확대될 전망이다.

headlines.title: 용산 어린이정원 , 추가 택지공급에 포함
headlines.summary: ■ 내달 7.3만호 추가공급 발표 25평형 2만호 안팎 공급 가능 ‘GB해제’ 등 서울시 충돌 전망 국토차관 “市와 협의 잘 된다면 추가 공급물량 더 기대할 수도” 뉴시스 정부가 서울 등 수도권에 추가 공급하기로 한 주택 7만3000호의 구체적인 입지를 이르면 내달 발표한다.

headlines.title: ‘ 어린이정원 ’까지 허물겠다는 정부 … 녹지 긁어모아 7.3만호 공급 논란

headlines.title: 물량보다 ‘ 보상→착공 ’ 속도 … 주민갈등 해결 여부도 성패 관건 [8·13 ...

headlines.title: “ 전월세난 급한 불 끄겠지만 보증규제 ‘126%룰’ 풀어야” [8·13 공급...
headlines.summary: 정부, 비아파트 공급 정상화 속도 비아파트 착공 4년 새 4분의 1 토막 업계 “민간 공급 여력 늘어 긍정적” 정부가 8·13대책을 통해 민간 비아파트 공급 정상화를 위한 지원책을 내놓으면서 전월세난이 완화될 수 있을지 주목된다.

headlines.title: “ 착공 지지부진 3기 신도시 … 인프라구축 우선돼야 신뢰 회복 ”

headlines.title: 당국, 전 금융권 소집 … “ 실수요자 차질 없는 자금 지원을 ”

headlines.title: ‘ 관세 ’보다 ‘ 환율 변동성 ’이 무섭다 ...중견기업 47.3%, “수출 악화...

headlines.title: “ 숙련공 필요하지만 인건비 부담 ”… 중기 ‘ 정년연장 ’ 딜레마

key_headlines.title: Import Prices Fall for Second Consecutive Month While Export Prices Rise on Semiconductor Boom
key_headlines.summary: July import prices declined 1% month-over-month for the second consecutive month due to weakening won-dollar exchange rates and international oil prices, while export prices rose 1% driven by semiconductor strength, improving Korea's terms of trade significantly.

key_headlines.title: Mid-sized Companies Fear Exchange Rate Volatility More Than Tariffs in Export Outlook
key_headlines.summary: 47.3% of mid-sized companies cite exchange rate volatility as the primary threat to exports rather than tariffs, with firms shifting focus toward emerging markets in Southeast Asia and India to diversify export destinations.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Recovers 7000 Level After 15 Trading Days on Fed Inflation Relief and Semiconductor Strength
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI surpassed the 7000 benchmark for the first time in 15 trading days, rising approximately 3%, supported by easing US inflation concerns and strong semiconductor stock performance.

key_headlines.title: Government Doubles Household Loan Growth Target to 3% to Address Housing Finance Crisis
key_headlines.summary: The government increased the annual household loan growth target from 1.5% to 3% as part of the August 13 real estate stabilization plan, aiming to ease difficulties in housing-related group loans including moving costs, interim payments, and final payments.

key_headlines.title: Government Accelerates Non-Apartment Housing Supply to Address Jeonse Price Surge
key_headlines.summary: The government unveiled support measures to normalize private non-apartment supply through the August 13 package, noting that non-apartment construction starts have dropped to one-quarter of their levels four years ago, with industry viewing increased private supply capacity positively.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economy shows mixed signals with export momentum strengthening on semiconductor sector gains while employment and inflation pressures persist. Import prices have declined for two consecutive months due to favorable exchange rates and oil prices, while export prices rose 1% driven by semiconductor strength, improving the country's terms of trade. However, mid-sized companies remain cautious, with 47.3% expressing concerns about exchange rate volatility as the primary threat to export performance, prompting diversification toward emerging markets. The government has responded with comprehensive policy measures including doubling household loan growth targets and accelerating housing supply to address persistent economic challenges.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: July employment data shows mixed results with jobless numbers increasing by 108,000 year-over-year, though the unemployment rate rose to 2.6%, up 0.2 percentage points annually. Consumer price inflation moderated to 2.8% in July from 3.2% in June, but personal services inflation increased from 3.4% to 3.5%, suggesting persistent cost pressures in certain sectors. The government maintains that economic recovery momentum is strengthening on the back of export gains and industrial production improvements, though uncertainties related to Middle East tensions and US tariff measures continue to weigh on the outlook. Employment rate declined slightly to 63.3%, down 0.1 percentage point year-over-year, presenting ongoing labor market challenges despite positive export trends.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI rebounded to 7000 level for the first time in 15 trading days, driven by easing US inflation expectations and strong semiconductor stocks, with gains around 3% from previous close at 6813.34. The KOSDAQ also advanced 0.38% to 864.65 as market sentiment improved following softer-than-expected inflation data. US long-term Treasury yields hit 25-year highs despite moderating inflation, reflecting concerns over America's 40 trillion dollar national debt and 123% debt-to-GDP ratio. The won-dollar exchange rate weakened to 1,418.3 won per dollar, down 1.1 won as currency volatility continues to concern Korean exporters and policymakers.
sections.Industry & Technology: LG Electronics and NVIDIA have established a strategic alliance to develop humanoid robots, with NVIDIA providing AI technology while LG contributes actuators, sensors, and batteries from its subsidiary ecosystem. HD Hyundai Heavy Industries secured new orders for US data center power generation facilities and energy infrastructure projects, demonstrating strength in advanced industrial sectors. China's automotive component industry is undergoing major transformation as electric vehicles and autonomous driving expand, with emphasis shifting from mega-casting and aluminum bodies to multi-material and smart chassis solutions. Korean semiconductor and technology firms are positioning themselves to benefit from this global transition and expanding AI commercialization across multiple industrial applications.
sections.Real Estate: The government announced the August 13 real estate stabilization package, doubling the annual household loan growth target to 3% to address the housing finance crisis affecting reconstruction and redevelopment projects, with moving cost loans now available up to higher percentages of property values. Non-apartment housing supply is being prioritized through regulatory relaxation of reconstruction and redevelopment requirements, including lowering initial consent rates, as starts have plummeted to one-quarter of levels four years ago. July household loans increased 6.2 trillion won across financial institutions, though growth remained sluggish at 35.3 trillion won cumulatively for the first seven months, as jeonse (long-term rental) demand and installment payment needs moderated. Lotte Construction opened a model house for Sangdong Station Lotte Castle Signature in Bucheon, drawing diverse age groups with strong early interest in the 1,859-unit development in a prime transit-oriented location.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration is imposing tariffs up to 100% on Chinese drones and related components, marking another escalation in US-China trade tensions with particular focus on DJI and other Chinese manufacturers. US long-term Treasury yields reached 25-year highs despite inflation moderation, raising concerns about global economic impacts from America's massive 40 trillion dollar national debt. The Federal Reserve's next FOMC meeting in September is expected to hold interest rates steady rather than increase them, following softer inflation data on both consumer and producer price indices. Vietnam has become increasingly strategic in US-China competition, attracting senior diplomatic representatives from major powers including the US, China, Japan, Russia, and Korea seeking to strengthen economic and security partnerships.
sections.AI & Economy: Economic experts largely dismiss concerns of massive AI-driven unemployment, noting that artificial intelligence adoption has not yet caused significant employment reductions but rather transformed work methodologies and business operations. Notta achieved 7.4 billion won in first-half revenue by expanding beyond AI optimization into agent operations and AI semiconductor ecosystem applications with customers like Arm and Furiosa AI. Asic Land recorded 273% revenue surge in the first half on surging demand for memory and storage-related semiconductors as the AI market intensifies competition in data processing and power efficiency. Nonghyup Mutual Finance is launching company-wide AI transformation initiatives including generative AI services, AI meeting transcription, and document drafting tools to enhance employee productivity and improve financial service quality.
sections.Others: US Federal Appeals Court ruling on tariff unconstitutionality triggered a 9.6 billion dollar customs refund windfall for over 40 American companies including Apple (2.1 billion dollars) and Nike, with FedEx and others sharing refund benefits with customers. The Trump administration signed a National Security Presidential Memorandum allowing foreign shipbuilders investing in US facilities to export up to 2 vessels to America, potentially accelerating Musk's space projects and diversifying US maritime capabilities. South Korea is exploring small modular reactor (SMR) investments as part of 200 billion dollar advanced industry investment commitments made to the US, with SMR emerging as a leading candidate for future bilateral cooperation. The Ministry of Health and Welfare established the seventh Long-Term Care Insurance Committee, with 2024 year-end data showing insurance revenue of 13.67 trillion won against expenditures of 13.43 trillion won, requiring careful fiscal monitoring.
